title: Exact Universality of Online Discrepancy
summary: We study online vector balancing with $N$ random vectors in $\mathbb{R}^M$ revealed sequentially, where each vector must be assigned an irrevocable sign upon arrival. The goal is to minimize the expected $\ell^\infty$ norm of the final signed sum. For i.i.d. entries with mean zero, variance one, and a finite fourth moment, we prove that, as $M/N\toα\in(0,\infty)$, the optimal value divided by $\sqrt N$ converges to a limit $R_α$ independent of the entry distribution.
